user.title: What does this remote control?
user.description: Pick the closest match. The device then works like any other in Home Assistant, with the right controls on your dashboard.

menu_option_descriptions.tv: Power, volume, channels and inputs. Works as a media player.
menu_option_descriptions.projector: Power and inputs. Works as a media player.
menu_option_descriptions.speaker: Power, volume, inputs and playback. Works as a media player.
menu_option_descriptions.fan: Power and oscillation, with speed and mode buttons. Works as a fan.
menu_option_descriptions.blinds: Open, close and stop. Works as a cover.
menu_option_descriptions.screen: Up, down and stop. Works as a cover.
menu_option_descriptions.generic: Name each button yourself and get a list of buttons.

command_name.title: Learn a button
command_name.description:
Which button on the remote do you want to learn next? After you select **Next**, you have 30 seconds to press it.

Learned so far: {learned}.

Leave the name empty and select **Next** when you are done.

data_description.name: For example, Power, Volume up or HDMI 1.

menu_options.save_next: Save and learn the next button

data_description.name: For example, Living room TV.
data_description.emitter_entity_id: Sends the commands to the device.
data_description.receiver_entity_id: Hears your remote while you teach it buttons.

ready_relearn.description: Press it on the remote when asked. It keeps its name.

progress.wait_for_signal: Point your remote at the receiver and press **{name}**. Waiting for 30 seconds.

error.no_signal: Nothing was received in 30 seconds. Point the remote at the receiver from close by and try again.

abort.no_emitters: No infrared emitter found. Add a device that can send infrared first.
abort.no_receivers: No infrared receiver found. Add a device that can receive infrared first.

relearn.title: Learn a button again
relearn.description: The button keeps its name and entity. Only the signal is replaced.

rename.title: Rename buttons
rename.description: Entity IDs stay the same, so automations keep working.

delete.title: Delete buttons
delete.description: The buttons and their entities are removed.

data_description.listen: Fires an event when the receiver hears one of the learned buttons from the original remote. Use it to trigger automations.
